C0869.title: FBI Opposes Paying Ransomware Ransoms
C0869.summary: In its ransomware safety guidance, the FBI states that it does not support paying ransoms to ransomware attackers and warns that payment does not guarantee that victims or their organizations will recover any data. The guidance also urges victims to report ransomware incidents to the FBI so law enforcement can track attackers, identify attack infrastructure, and help other potential victims.
